subject: AWS partner intro: BrightLeaf customer handoff + launch planning
messages:
From: Samir Patel <partner-lead@amazon.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Evelyn Torres <evelyn@brightleaf.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Intro: BrightLeaf + Redwood (AWS co-sell)

Hi Michael—

Quick intro: I'm Samir from AWS Partner Programs. BrightLeaf (Evelyn CC'd) is evaluating hosted inference options for a time-series analytics product and asked for an intro to Redwood to evaluate a co-sell engagement and potential marketplace listing. Evelyn mentioned they need a predictable latency SLA and a path to joint marketing.

Would love to set a 30–45 minute bridge call next week to:
- Introduce teams and roles (sales + technical)
- Surface primary use case and throughput/latency targets
- Align on mutual action plan (MAP) and marketplace listing steps

Proposed times: Tue 12/1 10:00–10:45 PT or Wed 12/2 11:00–11:45 PT. Let me know what works and who from Redwood should join (sales, solutions engineer, partner PM).

Thanks,
Samir
Partner Programs — AWS Marketplace
partner-lead@amazon.com

——
Attachments: none
From: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <partner-lead@amazon.com>, Evelyn Torres <evelyn@brightleaf.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro: BrightLeaf + Redwood (AWS co-sell)

Thanks for the intro, Samir — and hi Evelyn, great to meet you.

We'd be happy to run a bridge call. I'll join and bring Karthik (solutions) and Lauren (partner ops) who will help with marketplace onboarding. To make the call productive, I attached a one-page mutual action plan template that we typically use to capture milestones (tech validation, PoC, contract/marketplace listing, joint marketing).

Suggested short agenda for the bridge call (30–45m):
1) 5m — Introductions & objectives
2) 10m — BrightLeaf use case and current architecture (throughput, latency, data sovereignty)
3) 10m — Redwood approach: deployment options (hosted/dedicated/private) and quick perf/price profile
4) 5–10m — Marketplace and co-sell milestones (lead handoff, listing, PR/marketing)
5) 5m — Action items & owners

Availability: Tue 12/1 10:00 PT works for me. Evelyn — does that time fit your team? Also it would help if you shared key success metrics (RPS, p95 latency, token volumes per month) and any procurement timelines.

Attached: mutual_action_plan_template.xlsx (one-page MAP).

Best,
Michael Grant
Head of Solutions — Redwood Inference
michael_grant@redwood.com

Attachments: mutual_action_plan_template.xlsx (spreadsheet, 34 KB)
From: Evelyn Torres <evelyn@brightleaf.ai>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>, Samir Patel <partner-lead@amazon.com>
Cc: (none)
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 08:18:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Intro: BrightLeaf + Redwood (AWS co-sell)

Thanks Michael and Samir — Tue 12/1 10:00 PT works for our team. I'll have:
- Evelyn Torres, CEO (decision owner)
- Priya Desai, Head of Engineering (technical lead)
- Marcus Li, DevOps (platform requirements)

Quick context so we can hit the ground running:
- Production target: Jan 2027 for initial feature launch (tight timeline)
- Expected throughput: ~2k requests/min peak, avg 600–800 req/min; p95 latency goal <= 300ms for model inference
- Data residency: US only (no cross-region replication)
- Procurement: aiming to finalize partner contract + marketplace participation by mid-December

I've attached a draft SOW that shows the initial scope and commercial expectations — it's preliminary but will give you an idea of timing and deliverables.

See you on the call.

—Evelyn
Evelyn Torres | CEO, BrightLeaf Analytics
evelyn@brightleaf.ai

Attachments: SOW-draft-BrightLeaf.pdf (PDF, 82 KB)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Torres <evelyn@brightleaf.ai>, Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Samir Patel <partner-lead@amazon.com>
Date: Thu, 02 Dec 2026 14:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Intro: BrightLeaf + Redwood (AWS co-sell)

Great call earlier — thanks everyone for the time. Quick recap + next steps so we have alignment: 

Recap (high level):
- BrightLeaf primary needs: low p95 latency <=300ms, US-only residency, production launch target Jan 2027, projected traffic ~2k rpm peak.
- Redwood suggested paths: Hosted (fastest time-to-value) or Dedicated (SLA + isolated GPU pool) for predictable latency.
- AWS will facilitate marketplace listing and co-sell introduction to the field team once MAP & contract are in place.

Immediate next actions (owners):
- Michael: share a short performance baseline doc and an estimated cost range for Hosted vs Dedicated for the expected volumes by 12/4. (attachment: perf_cost_estimate.xlsx — forthcoming)
- Priya (BrightLeaf): provide a short environment details sheet (instances, model size, expected sequence lengths) by 12/3.
- Lauren: start marketplace intake paperwork and share required docs (security questionnaire, logo assets) by 12/6.
- Samir: open the AWS co-sell request and create a Partner Opportunity (please share the PRM link).

Related links: HubSpot deal DL-2026-0987, MAP template shared during call.

I'll also schedule a follow-up on Dec 8 for a technical deep-dive with Priya and our infra team. If anyone needs a separate commercial sync earlier, say so and we'll set it.

Thanks — Karthik
Sr Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com
